$comment: Shared vectors for the name comparison the cross-cour guard consults: frontend/src/lib/history/same-name.ts and backend/src/commands/cour_same_name.rs each run every vector and must agree with `names_entry`. Not recordings, so `make fixtures-refresh` does not apply. A vector's `title` is a provider title (or a show key's slug words) and `names` every title of a Kitsu entry — canonical, localized, abbreviated — copied from Kitsu where the case names an id.

vectors.json.source: Hand-assembled. 11 pairs of a hianime card title with the Kitsu entry it names, the entry's titles read from kitsu.io on 2026-11-01; 5 pairs the guard refuses, with the same entries; one show key's slug words; and the comparison's edges: the legacy episode-count tail, cour numbers at and past u32 and past double precision, ordinal spellings, full-width digits, non-ASCII case, a name that is a prefix of another.
